intent_en: To illustrate the global decline in smallpox cases that led to the disease's official eradication in 1980.
previous_intent: To illustrate the global decline in reported smallpox cases over the 20th century, culminating in the disease's eradication in 1980.
narration_support: It worked really well, not just in India but around the world. And on May 8th, 1980, the World Health Organization declared smallpox eradicated.
chart_support: Line chart showing reported global smallpox cases from 1920 to 1980, displaying a significant downward trend in case numbers that approaches zero by 1980.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the eradication in 1980 and that the effort was successful, which is visually supported by the chart showing cases dropping to near zero by that year.
